title: Negative numbers and integers
summary: Carry the number line on to the left of zero. Show temperatures below zero and depths below sea level, then add and subtract with jumps.
guide: Numbers to the right of zero are {{term:positive-number}}s and numbers to the left of zero are {{term:negative-number}}s. Zero is neither positive nor negative. Together they are the {{term:integer}}s.

The minus sign always goes on the left: {{num:-4}} is "negative four" (or "minus four"). A temperature of 4 degrees below zero is written {{num:-4}} °C. 4 and {{num:-4}} are the same distance from zero, on opposite sides.
On the number line, numbers get bigger from left to right. So the further left a number is, the smaller it is: {{num:-8}} is less than {{num:-3}}.
Adding a positive number is a jump to the right. Subtracting a positive number is a jump to the left. The arc over the line shows the jump.

engine.label-line: Number line: tap to place a point

below-zero.title: 4 degrees below zero
below-zero.prompt: On a cold winter night, the {{term:temperature}} was 4 degrees below zero. Show it on the line. Predict first: is it left or right of zero?
below-zero.hint: Temperatures below zero are negative and sit to the left of zero. Go 4 steps left from 0.
below-zero.success: Well done! 4 degrees below zero is {{num:-4}} °C.
below-zero.why: {{num:-4}} and 4 are both 4 steps from zero. So what is the difference?
below-zero.model: {{num:-4}} is to the left of zero and 4 is to the right. They are the same distance from zero, but in opposite directions.

feedback.count: Put one point on the line.
feedback.too-big: Your point is too far right. Below zero means left of zero. Go exactly 4 steps left from 0.
feedback.too-small: Too far left. {{num:-4}} is between {{num:-5}} and 0. Go only 4 steps left from 0.

deeper.title: Which is lower?
deeper.prompt: Call sea level zero. A fish is 8 m below the surface ({{num:-8}}) and a turtle is 3 m below the surface ({{num:-3}}). Both are marked on the line. Which number is smaller?
deeper.hint: On the number line, the number further left is smaller.
deeper.success: Correct! {{num:-8}} is less than {{num:-3}} because it is further left. The fish is lower.
deeper.why: 8 is bigger than 3. So why is {{num:-8}} smaller than {{num:-3}}?
deeper.model: For negative numbers, the bigger the number after the sign, the further it is from zero, to the left. 8 m under water is lower than 3 m under water, so {{num:-8}} is smaller.

feedback.empty: Choose one of the two numbers.
feedback.wrong: 8 is bigger than 3, but {{num:-8}} is to the left of {{num:-3}}. On the number line, the number further left is smaller.

warmer.title: Getting warmer
warmer.prompt: In the morning it was {{num:-3}} °C. By midday it was 5 degrees warmer. Jump 5 steps from {{num:-3}} and tap where you land. What is {{num:-3}} + 5?
warmer.hint: Warmer means the temperature goes up: jump to the right. 3 steps to get to zero, then 2 more.
warmer.why: You started at a negative number, but the answer is positive. Why?
warmer.model: From {{num:-3}} to zero is only 3 steps. We jumped 5, so we went 2 more steps past zero and landed on 2.

feedback.count: Put one point where the 5-step jump lands.
feedback.too-small: Adding a positive number means jumping right. Go 5 steps right from {{num:-3}}; the arc should say +5.
feedback.too-big: Too far. Start at {{num:-3}}, not 3: 3 steps to zero, then 2 more.

colder.title: Getting colder
colder.prompt: In the evening it was 3 °C. By midnight it was 7 degrees colder. Jump 7 steps left from 3. What is 3 − 7?
colder.hint: 3 steps to zero, then 4 more to the left.
colder.success: Well done! 3 − 7 = {{num:-4}}. At midnight it was 4 degrees below zero.
colder.why: Zahra said 3 − 7 = 4. Why is that wrong?
colder.model: She took 3 away from 7. But we start at 3 and go 7 steps left: 3 steps to zero and 4 steps past it. So we land on {{num:-4}}, not 4.

feedback.count: Put one point where the 7-step jump lands.
feedback.too-big: Not far enough left. From 3, go 7 steps left: after 3 steps you reach zero and there are still 4 to go. Keep going past zero.
feedback.too-small: Too far. Start at 3 and go just 7 steps left; the arc should say −7.
